messages:
maria: quick sync — i'm proposing a 'token health workshop' to close the postmortem action items: token validation gaps, audit-log holes, and secrets rotation cadence. who can join thursday?
aj: +1. i can lead the validation tests/automation. need clear owners for each action.
liam: i'll take audit logging gaps. q: are we centralizing to the cloud logging pipeline or keeping service-level copies? linked some notes: https://internal.redwood/logs/arch
emma: product can help scope customer-impacting cases. please prep a short runbook draft before the workshop.
julie: oncall here — observed recurring failure spikes during deploy windows where tokens aren't reloaded and services error for ~3–5m. suggestion: add graceful reload + stagger restarts.
sre-bot: created issue #5843: "token-validation-tests and automation" (https://issues.redwood/5843)
maria: ownership proposal: validation -> aj, audit -> liam, rotation cadence -> julie, runbook + customer triage -> emma. timeline: owners to post triage + proposed fix by EOW (fri). if blocked, update issue with blocker + ETA.
aj: plan: add an e2e that simulates key rotation and validates token chains across service restarts. test will run in CI and as a periodic job. ETA: fri eod. quick example I will use in the test: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${ROTATED_TOKEN}' https://api.redwood-inference/v1/health`
liam: audit plan: add ingest rule for token events, ensure we capture `kid` and rotation metadata; retention policy to keep 90 days searchable. i'll draft mapping + kibana saved view. ETA: mon next week.
julie: rotation schedule thought: we should avoid weekly rolling for all tenants. propose monthly rotation by default + emergency rotation playbook. candidate cron for monthly rotation (UTC): `0 03 1 * *` — i'll draft the playbook and a staged rollout for dedicated customers.
emma: i'll surface affected customers (ticket #9812) and reprioritize if there's user-visible impact. also want a short SLA note for token-related errors.
maria: proposed alert: `token_validation_fail_rate > 0.5% over 10m` -> page SRE + ticket to owners. also add a daily token-health digest to the #incidents channel for the week after rollout.
aj: i'll add the alert query and smoke test to the issue. will also include a small helper script to rotate a test key and validate downstream caches.
maria: summary of action items (for the workshop):
- aj: implement e2e rotation/validation tests + CI job (ETA: fri)
- liam: ingest rule + retention + kibana view (ETA: mon)
- julie: rotation playbook + staged rollout cadence (ETA: next wed)
- emma: customer impact triage + SLA note (ETA: fri)
- maria: add alert + schedule token-health digest; coordinate workshop agenda (ETA: tmrw)
please add short updates to the corresponding issue so i can track in one place. :thumbsup:
aj: ack — i'll drop a PR link in #eng-releases and update #incidents once the CI job is green.
liam: will post the mapping + sample query to the issue.
maria: thanks all — i'll send calendar invite for thursday 10am and attach the initial agenda + runbook sketch.
julie: noted, i'll attend and bring deploy logs from last friday.
emma: will join too.
aj: see you all.
sre-bot: reminder scheduled: workshop invite sent to participants (maria, aj, liam, emma, julie).
